ctx.x: And that's when you see all these dancers like tap dancers in on-the-town dance, you see. And they each had a chance to reintroduce, you see, the remedy, see. And that's what happened, see.

And you had to stand there. You had to stand up like a -- great sentries or something, you know. Like at attention. Like doing reveille and so forth. Of course -- had all kinds of stories going on in the show, see, but they was all mostly based on on-the-town dancing, you see. And he was very pleased and surprised. And even Mr. Joe Franklin, he was -- he heard about it, you know. So, I have to laugh when I think about Joe, you see, because he's -- I knew him since I
was growing, you know. And I was on a radio show in the south.
